characters.name: Chad Emberstorm

leaderSkill.name: Leg Day Never Ends
leaderSkill.desc: Fire allies ATK x2.5. At 6+ combo, all allies ATK x1.3.

activeSkill.name: Protein Inferno
activeSkill.desc: Convert Water orbs to Fire orbs and increase attack for this turn.

passive.name: Spot Me, Bro
passive.desc: Fire attacks against Nature enemies deal +20% damage.

awakened.abilityDesc: Protein Inferno also extends move time by 2 seconds. Fire attacks gain a burning trail.

characters.flavor: Once bench-pressed a volcano 'for form practice'. The volcano still sends him holiday cards.

characters.name: Queen Cindra

leaderSkill.name: Royal Decree of Warmth
leaderSkill.desc: Fire and Light allies HP x1.5, ATK x2.

activeSkill.name: Throne Room Flashover
activeSkill.desc: Deal heavy Fire damage to all enemies.

passive.name: Regally Flammable
passive.desc: Immune to bind while any Fire orb is on the board.

awakened.epithet: Empress of the Extremely Toasty Throne
awakened.abilityDesc: Throne Room Flashover ignores elemental resistance and gains a full-screen cut-in.

characters.flavor: Her throne is a heated recliner. Her crown is a tiny bonfire. Her rule is absolute and cozy.

characters.name: Brenda Broilmore

leaderSkill.name: Low and Slow
leaderSkill.desc: Fire allies ATK x1.8 and REC x1.5.

activeSkill.name: Flavor Verdict
activeSkill.desc: Convert Heart orbs to Fire orbs. Score: 10/10.

characters.flavor: Disqualified a dragon for using its own breath. 'Store-bought heat,' she wrote. 'Zero points.'

characters.name: Ignatius Pott

activeSkill.name: Emergency Simmer
activeSkill.desc: Heal the party and reduce damage taken this turn.

passive.name: Camp Rules
passive.desc: Takes 20% less damage from Water enemies. Leave no trace.

characters.flavor: Achieved consciousness after burning one (1) perfect marshmallow. Has pursued excellence ever since.

characters.name: Sparky the Intern

activeSkill.name: Coffee Run
activeSkill.desc: Extend move time by 3 seconds this turn. He runs FAST.

characters.flavor: Promised 'exposure' as payment. He is a being of pure light and heat. He has plenty of exposure.

characters.name: Sizzle Goblin Greg

activeSkill.name: Grease Fire
activeSkill.desc: Deal Fire damage to one enemy. Kitchen closed.

passive.name: Non-Stick
passive.desc: Cannot be caught by lock effects... 30% of the time.

characters.flavor: His secret ingredient is a small, contained kitchen fire. His other secret ingredient is salt.

characters.name: Warm Rock

activeSkill.name: Radiate
activeSkill.desc: Heal the party a little. It's doing its best.

passive.name: Rock
passive.desc: It is a rock. Takes 10% less damage.

characters.flavor: Found on a beach. Adopted immediately. Currently the party's emotional cornerstone.

characters.name: Match Boy Timmy

activeSkill.name: Strike a Match
activeSkill.desc: Convert one orb to a Fire orb. One.

passive.name: Supervised
passive.desc: Gains +5% ATK when next to an adult party member.

characters.flavor: Carries exactly one match at all times. The kingdom's insurance adjusters know him by name.
